sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My friend and I stop at a café across from our hotel.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: After a wet walk, we check the menu display.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, we're thinking of sharing the soup and bread.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, the large soup comes with two slices of bread.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: That sounds good. Is the soup spicy?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: It's mild, but there's a hot sauce you can add.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Could we have the sauce on the side?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Of course. Would you like anything to drink?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Just two glasses of water, please.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: No problem. Take a seat and we'll bring everything over.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We sit by the window and watch the rain.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The worker sets down one big bowl and the bread.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Here you go. Careful, the bowl's quite hot.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks. Could we have an extra bowl?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: We'd like a bowl each, if that's okay.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, I'll get you a small bowl and another spoon.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, then we can each add what we like.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: You can add the hot sauce once you've split the soup.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Good idea. My friend likes it much hotter than I do.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He brings the extra bowl, then points to a small pot.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's the hot sauce. Start with a little.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I thought that was more soup!

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Careful, even a little can be quite hot.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I'll leave that to my friend, then.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: By the way, you can get more bread for a pound at the counter.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, how much is the extra bread?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: One pound for two slices.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: We'll have that too, please. Can I pay now?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's nine pounds altogether. You can tap right here.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I pass my friend the bread while she adds the sauce.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: This is just what I needed after that walk.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We finish lunch as the sun comes out over the street.
